profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.geoLocationName: North Las Vegas, Nevada, United States
profile.summary: Growth-minded individual and experienced Software Engineer adept in creating micro-service oriented programs that will create a lasting impact on its community. Motivated and eager to contribute skills in team collaboration, problem-solving and organizational techniques to improve processes, productivity and service quality. Proficient in various platforms, languages, and embedded systems such as: Java/Eclipse, C#, Docker/Kubernetes, Node.js, and Git.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.locationName: Las Vegas, Nevada, United States · Remote

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
positions.description:
• Designed, implemented and maintained cloud-native solutions to maintain
sustainable product for internal development and customers across Motorola's suite of applications.
• Worked collaboratively within an agile team to deliver high quality and thoroughly tested products and features, seeing them through from conception to delivery.
• Effectively communicated and collaborated in a multi-team/multinational environment with teams spanning the globe.
• Helped develop upon an existing project that displayed active or inactive customers and what product those customers were using. Utilized Angular and a Motorola internal Angular library to re-imagine the UI of the project. As well as restructuring the JavaScript codebase into TypeScript and making the entire project more readable for future developers.

positions.title: Business Office Associate
positions.description:
• Assisted all store departments in their daily functions while adhering to CarMax guidelines. 
• Provided customer service by greeting customers, balancing overflow traffic, listening to and answering customer questions and explaining paperwork processes. 
• Sought win/win solutions for the customer and partners appropriately. 
• Processed paperwork associated with retail/wholesale automobile sales, which included printing daily reports, maintaining deal jackets, contacting finance companies regarding contracts, obtaining required information regarding registration and/or titling, processing reassignments, and auditing completed paperwork. 
• Processed auction sales, dealer registration, and/or appraisal lane purchases to include the collection of titles (calls and follow up).

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Developed an application with in .NET Core using Windows Services to create an autonomous event escalating system to update tickets based off custom attributes and filters.
• Lead a project to create an API that will allow Grafana metric data from an AWS Kubernetes cluster to be sent to an internal server that will ingest it, transform it into Prometheus metrics, and serve it to the internal Prometheus server.
• Worked with a team to develop a React front-end application to connect existing web applications through Single Sign-On and OAuth.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Worked within a team to sift through, organize, and document an existing Node.js code base for future developers 
• Assisted with a front-end web application through Adobe XD wireframe mockups. 
• Debugged software, identified root causes, and proposed solutions to software issues

positions.locationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States

positions.title: Resident Advisor
positions.description:
• Implemented and enforced all College and Campus Living policies, promoting academic excellence, addressing student needs, and encouraging involvement. 
• Developed a positive living environment for residents, often resolving conflicts. 
• Collaborated with orientation staff on first year and transfer student opening week activities. 
• Budgeted, created expense reports, and allocated approved funding used for residence hall and floor events.
• Assisted in the selection, evaluation and training of newly hired Resident Advisors..

positions.title: Capstone
positions.description:
• Developed an application that accomplished creating a user friendly mobile app that provided introductory information on the stock market.
• The front-end was created using Android Studio and utilized Adobe XD wireframe mock-ups to help plan the connection between pages.
• Engineered a microservice-oriented Spring Boot back-end that handled a MySQL user database, real-time stock ticker APIs, Netflix/Eureka service registry with a Zuul gateway, and Docker to host the application locally.

positions.title: Recreation Specialist
positions.locationName: North Las Vegas, Nevada, United States
positions.description:
• Supervised children and teens from the ages of 5-17 from a variety of backgrounds. 
• Provided children with an enriching and safe environment for them to use to do homework or socialize after school hours as they wait for their parent(s)/guardian(s) to pick them up. 
• General janitorial duties to ensure that the workplace is neat and maintained in a presentable manner.

positions.title: Restaurant Worker
positions.description:
• Processed orders in a timely manner to assure that customers were served quality made food efficiently.
• Performed daily cleaning and maintenance tasks to keep the restaurant clean and organized
• Provided a memorable dining experience for guests by offering attentive service and suggesting menu items
• Accurately managed customer orders and payment transactions.
